Author: Tensho
Name: Tensho Assistant
Description:
Everyday tools in one window (/tensho), with a guide and help on every page.

Items and storage (bags, retainers, saddlebags, armoury chest, glamour dresser, armoire), inventory
sorting rules, market listings and prices, retainer sale prices compared on a click, recipes, a crafting
simulator and solver, gathering and fishing with Eorzea time windows and weather, a map that replaces
the game map (quests, leves, FATEs, gathering points, vendors, aether currents, teleport costs), weather,
alarms and reminders, free company voyages and builds, quests and rewards, collections with how to
obtain each item, a gear planner (materia, try on, build sharing), duty and monster loot, Beastmaster
information, Fashion Report hints, Mini Cactpot, Triple Triad helpers (against NPCs only), character
stats, macro chains and a Credits page listing every source.

Network: community data (Universalis, Garland Tools, FFXIV Console Games Wiki, Teamcraft bite times,
PaissaDB open plots, and files hosted on GitHub: LuminaSupplemental, GatherBuddy, FFXIVGachaSpreadsheet)
is requested over HTTPS only when you open or hover the matching tool, click, or a setting asks for it,
with bounded replies and a disk cache. Each source has a switch in Settings > Data and sources. This plugin's own
repository is read on a click for the gallery of community tools (data only, no code) and the help
videos, and for the shared discoveries exchange on « Exchange now » or with the optional automatic exchange (off by
default), without any account. Your own sightings (places, items, the day of each; a fish caught carries
your character's exact spot) are sent to an unlisted gist linked from a public issue only after you connect
GitHub. On « Install », the optional desktop app is downloaded from this repository's releases (SHA-256
checked). No character name or id is sent; Tensho alarms and currency cap alerts go to a Discord webhook
only if you enter one (off by default), with your character's name only if you ask for it. An item's page on the wiki or the Lodestone, and partake.gg (player events), open in your browser
only on a click or a /tensho command. Reporting a problem opens a prefilled form in your browser; you read
it and send it yourself.

Actions that reach the game (teleport, applying a sort, a macro chain, writing crafting macros, opening
Try On, equipping a gear set, sending the hunt train call to the chat channel you choose) start only when you click them. Game
alarms are created with /alarm when you add an alarm with the « game alarms » setting on (off by default)
or press Send. One setting, off by default, acts without a click: wearing the title you chose for a job
when you change job. No automation of crafting, dialogues or loot, no PvP feature, no parser.

AI disclosure: the code and the icon were generated with an AI coding agent (Claude), directed and tested
in game by the author.

Languages: English and French; German and Japanese: menu titles only.
Punchline: One window for everyday tools: items, crafting, gathering, map, collections and more.

What changes for players:
- 0.1273: Desktop app: icons that showed as plain rectangles (navigation arrows, check marks, the garden's droplet) now draw correctly.
- 0.1272: New option « Follow Dalamud's style » (Settings › General, off by default): Tensho's windows take the colours and spacing of your Dalamud style, keeping Tensho's titles and accent.
- 0.1271: Desktop app: Tensho's dashboard now shows the game's gauges and curves of the last hour (memory, slowest page, requests a minute) when linked to the game.
- 0.1270: Tensho's dashboard: click a gauge to see its curve over the last hour.
- 0.1269: Tensho's dashboard now shows gauges: memory in use, the slowest page, requests a minute, plus counters for failed saves, panels turned off and unavailable readers.
- 0.1268: Tensho's map: monsters of a FATE now carry that FATE's own icon instead of a star, and the allies fighting beside you get a separate green mark.
- 0.1267: Map lists, panels, Triple Triad and squadron pages now flag waiting data and Tensho's estimates the same way as the rest of Tensho.
- 0.1266: Gathering pages now mark what Tensho estimates (Bountiful bonus, expected yield) with a small calculator, and what is read from the game as « Measured ».
- 0.1265: Crafting pages now tell what is read from the game (« Measured ») from what Tensho works out (« Estimate »), and flag waiting or old data like the rest of Tensho.
- 0.1264: Market and Storage pages now flag waiting, old or failed data the same way as the rest of Tensho, with a small icon and a short word.

Ce qui change pour les joueurs :
- 0.1273 : Application de bureau : les icônes qui s'affichaient en rectangles pleins (flèches de la navigation, coches, goutte du jardin) se dessinent correctement.
- 0.1272 : Nouvelle option « Suivre le style de Dalamud » (Paramètres › Général, désactivée par défaut) : les fenêtres de Tensho prennent les couleurs et les espacements de votre style Dalamud, en gardant les titres et l'accent de Tensho.
- 0.1271 : Application de bureau : le tableau de bord de Tensho montre les jauges du jeu et les courbes de la dernière heure (mémoire, page la plus lente, requêtes par minute) quand elle est reliée au jeu.
- 0.1270 : Tableau de bord de Tensho : un clic sur une jauge montre sa courbe sur la dernière heure.
- 0.1269 : Le tableau de bord de Tensho montre des jauges : mémoire utilisée, page la plus lente, requêtes par minute, et des compteurs pour les enregistrements ratés, les panneaux coupés et les lecteurs indisponibles.
- 0.1268 : Carte de Tensho : les monstres d'un ALÉA portent l'icône de cet ALÉA au lieu d'une étoile, et les alliés qui se battent à vos côtés ont une marque verte à part.
- 0.1267 : Les listes de la carte, les panneaux, la Triple Triade et l'escouade signalent une donnée en attente et les estimations de Tensho comme le reste de Tensho.
- 0.1266 : Les pages de récolte marquent d'une petite calculatrice ce que Tensho estime (bonus d'Abondance, rendement attendu) et de « Mesuré » ce qui est lu dans le jeu.
- 0.1265 : Les pages d'artisanat distinguent ce qui est lu dans le jeu (« Mesuré ») de ce que Tensho calcule (« Estimation »), et signalent une donnée en attente ou ancienne comme le reste de Tensho.
- 0.1264 : Les pages Marché et Rangements signalent une donnée en attente, ancienne ou en échec comme le reste de Tensho, avec une petite icône et un mot court.
